title: Textiles (fibre DPP)
notes: Top ESPR working-plan priority. Delegated act expected ~Q2 2027, compliance ~2028-2029. Fields are provisional and may change; no binding determination yet. retentionYears is assumed, not sourced: ESPR Art. 9(2)(i) sets no figure — it requires availability for at least the expected lifetime of the product, delegated per product group, and no textile delegated act has been adopted.
